# shoal_user (Resource)

A person in the tenant directory. With SSO, users are usually created on first sign-in or by SCIM; use this resource to pre-provision people or manage break-glass accounts. Maps to `/v1/users/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_user" "ada" {
  username     = "ada@acme.example"
  email        = "ada@acme.example"
  display_name = "Ada Lovelace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username (usually the email address). Changing it recreates the user.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Set to `false` to block sign-in and revoke the user's API keys.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI. Defaults to `username`.
- `email` (String) Email address; matched against verified OIDC emails on first sign-in.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Set of String) Ids of the groups the user belongs to.
- `id` (String) User id, used as `subject_id` in role bindings and group members.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_user.ada usr_01hx...
```
